title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 07 May 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 06 May 2026 Due to a developing low-level atmospheric disturbance in the vicinity of Sri Lanka, an increase in rainfall over the island is expected during the next few days. Showers or thundershowers will occur at most places of the island after 1.00 pm. Showers are likely in the Western and Southern provinces during the morning too. Heavy falls above 100 mm are likely at some places in Sabaragamuwa, Central, Uva, Southern and North-central provinces. Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places in other areas of the island. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva provinces during the early hours of the morning. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
